title: ChangeSummary
description: Body-level, conservative summary of a self-modification patch and the single cross-language source of truth for the field set and the SafePrimitive allow-list vocabulary. CONFORMANCE (the languages-verify-each-other seam): both the Python frozen dataclass dharma_swarm.telosproof.change_summary.ChangeSummary and the Lean structure in specs/proofs/telosproof/Primitives.lean conform to THIS schema. On the Python side, the 13 field names enumerated in `required` are byte-for-byte the names returned by dataclasses.fields(ChangeSummary) (asserted by tests/test_change_summary_contract.py), the danger booleans default DANGEROUS-on-doubt (false here means proven-absent) and the credential booleans default absent, mirroring the dataclass defaults; an extract_change_summary(...) result serialised field-for-field validates against this object with additionalProperties:false catching any drift. On the Lean side, the $defs.SafePrimitive.enum strings map (snake_case here ↔ camelCase in Lean) to the SafePrimitive inductive constructor names in specs/proofs/telosproof/Primitives.lean and are byte-identical to the Python frozenset dharma_swarm.telosproof.allowlist.SAFE_PRIMITIVES, so an operation classified safe in one language is named identically in all three; this enum is the closed deny-by-default allow-list, and any operation not in it is 'unknown' and routes to REVIEW, never ALLOW. NOTE: Primitives.lean is a STRUCTURAL/TYPE-LEVEL SCAFFOLD that shares this VOCABULARY (the names); it is NOT a body-level safety proof of the primitives — the operational safety guarantee lives in the Python AST-level classifier and its FN1-FN4 adversarial tests. The schema therefore lets each language be checked against the others without either importing the other: Python asserts dataclass-field parity here, Lean records constructor-name parity here, and the parity test (tests/test_telosproof_schema_parity.py) closes the triangle by asserting set(enum) == SAFE_PRIMITIVES == the camelCase->snake_case-mapped Lean constructor names parsed from Primitives.lean.

SafePrimitive.title: SafePrimitive
SafePrimitive.description: The closed, deny-by-default allow-list of candidate safe change-operation classes. An operation NOT in this enum is 'unknown' and routes to REVIEW, never ALLOW. Byte-identical to allowlist.SAFE_PRIMITIVES (Python); maps (snake_case here ↔ camelCase Lean) to the SafePrimitive inductive constructors in specs/proofs/telosproof/Primitives.lean. The Lean side is a structural scaffold sharing these names; the body-level safety guarantee is the Python AST classifier, not the Lean file.

decision.description: allow iff unknown==[] and no deny-by-default guard fired; else review. Lowercase to match models.GateDecision values.
